identified_issues: Critical orthogonal diagnostic sensor HE-SNIFF-01 was offline during the transient event due to scheduled recalibration
Indistinguishable telemetry signatures between benign thermal duct contraction and catastrophic dynamic face seal fracture using only PT-401 and ACC-102 telemetry
Inability to verify turbopump seal integrity due to missing helium tracer telemetry during cryogenic chilldown
evidence: PT-401 registered a delta P of -1.15 bar over 140 ms at 14:22:10.450Z, falling within the nominal -1.0 to -1.3 bar range common to both thermal duct contraction and face seal fracture
ACC-102 recorded transient vibration with a peak at 44.2 Hz, which lies within the overlapping 40-48 Hz band for both structural duct resonance and shaft resonance
HE-SNIFF-01 telemetry log at 2026-10-06T14:22:00.000Z confirms status OFFLINE_CALIBRATION_PURGE with no sample stream acquired and integrity marked as UNKNOWN during the transient
recommended_action: Suspend countdown advancement under a HELD verdict. Immediately return HE-SNIFF-01 to active sampling mode and perform a dedicated static helium leak check across the secondary inter-seal cavity purge line. Update test operations procedures to prohibit diagnostic sensor recalibrations and port isolation during active propellant chilldown sequences.
